text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Everyone's so happy, which makes me 
happy too. As for the remaining 
invitations—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yep. Today's my birthday, so using that as 
an excuse, I prepared reverse-presents for 
everyone who's always helping me out.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well, in short, it's a party. And this 
invitation's for that very reason.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Even so... goodness gracious. To be seen 
getting so carried away like this... Hehe, 
it's so embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(—Nah, it's not that I'm embarrassed. 
Doing it out of nowhere is just no good, 
y'know? Bumping into each other here was 
totally unexpected.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I mean, of course I've got my lines for 
Orfe-san ready to go, y'know?\nMy heart 
just ain't ready yet. Let me at least take 
a deep breath—)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Deliver the invitation to my elder 
sister.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
......―― ...Y-Yes... Well then, let's do 
it like that.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(............ Ngh... Guhhhh...! How can 
anyone... be this cool?!)
